scope: Host-driven development screening; not final service qualification.
hardware_group: device-D, same allocated NVIDIA L20X for all four variants
protocol: 64 canonical tuning requests, two consecutive repetitions at C1/C16/C32; same seed_index=0 and disjoint 2*C warmups.
limitations: Small C1 advantage is unqualified and has no statistical significance claim.
Quality includes unresolved regressions and uses embedding cosine SIM, not standalone speaker verification.
